kind.description: The record kind, a fixed tag.

outputs.description: The output selection of the best and probe rows.

alpha_feasible.description: The largest tested feasible alpha. Null when no tested alpha was feasible.

best_probe_index.description: The history index of the probe at alpha_feasible. Null when no tested alpha was feasible.

monotone_proven.description: Whether feasibility (every demand fits) is proven downward closed in alpha for this question class: an alpha below a feasible one is feasible, so the search's bracket is sound. Delivery itself need not be monotone in alpha.

proof.description: What makes feasibility downward closed in alpha (every alpha below a feasible one is feasible). Values: fixed_program (every demand forwards a program that does not change with alpha); single_controller (one centralized-TE demand without a tunnel count, or one optimized shortest-paths demand with a static route choice, alone in its set); nothing_offered (the set offers no traffic); unproved (no proof: the search is a heuristic).

upper_certificate.description: A proved bracket around the largest feasible alpha. Null when no bracket is proved.

search_status.description: How the search ended. Values: feasible (the gap between a feasible and an infeasible alpha closed to alpha_tolerance); limit (a feasible alpha was found, but the search reached alpha_max or an iteration limit); none_feasible (no tested alpha was feasible); range (a probe's scaled volumes left the native range, and the search stopped there); stagnation (the next bracketing value equals the current alpha, or a bisection midpoint rounds to a bracket endpoint); trivial (the set offers no traffic and one probe at alpha_max succeeded).

stop_reason.description: Why the search stopped. Values: tolerance (the gap closed to alpha_tolerance); alpha_bound (the search reached alpha_min or alpha_max); bracket_limit (max_bracket_iters ran out before a feasible and an infeasible alpha were found); bisect_limit (max_bisect_iters ran out before the gap closed); offer_range (a probe left the native range); representable_limit (the next bracketing value equals the current alpha, or a bisection midpoint rounds to a bracket endpoint); nothing_offered (the set offers no traffic); unit_resolution (no feasible alpha: each tested alpha either rounds some positive volume to zero units or does not fit).

history.description: Every probe in the order tested.

best_rows.description: The rows at alpha_feasible. Null when no tested alpha was feasible.

best_accounting.description: The accounting at alpha_feasible. Null when no tested alpha was feasible.

probe_rows.description: Rows of every probe. Absent when probe rows are not requested.

query.description: The analysis's typed query (a workflow step records it as the step's question instead). Absent when the analysis is a workflow step's result.

controller.description: The WCMP controller's tables of this demand set. Absent when no WCMP controller programs the set.

index.description: The probe's position in the search history (0 first).

outcome.description: feasible, infeasible, below_resolution (rounds to zero) or range (out of native range).

totals.description: The probe's totals. Null when the probe was out of range.

range_refusal.description: Why the probe was out of range. Null when the probe was in range.

kind.description: The record kind, a fixed tag.

demands.description: The declared demands of the set, as they were asked.

alpha_tolerance.description: The absolute width of the final alpha bracket at which bisection stops.

max_bracket_iters.description: The largest number of bracket probes.

max_bisect_iters.description: The largest number of bisection probes.

export_probe_rows.description: Whether every probe's rows are exported.

marginal_cost.description: The increase of the minimum total cost per additional unit.

units.description: The units delivered at that marginal cost.

kind.description: The record kind, a fixed tag.

cost_domain.description: physical_network, or analysis_graph when costs include the pool attachment's 1.

bins.description: The native marginal cost curve: each piece's marginal cost and units, in ascending cost.

edge.description: The member: a directed link leaving the router.

admission.description: lossless (admit the largest total whose splits fit, and refuse the rest before it enters) or lossy (send the whole offer; what does not fit is lost at the sources or on the links).

allocation.description: How a router splits over its members: equal, weighted or optimized. Null when it does not apply to the model.

source_allocation.description: How sources share the demand: equal, weighted or optimized. Null when it does not apply to the model.

source_weights.description: Weighted sources (CentralizedTE without tunnels): the question's declared weights, each graph node with a nonzero weight in node order (a zero weight receives nothing; all zero gives an empty list); a TE ingress pool's private head is named by its pool. Null when the sources are not weighted.

weight_basis.description: What weighted splits are proportional to. Null when it does not apply to the model.

edge_weights.description: Explicit edge weights. Null when the model has none.

tie_break.description: How equal-cost choices are ordered (ShortestPaths and T1). Null when the model is another one, or the WCMP controller programs the demand.

multipath.description: ShortestPaths: whether every equal-cost walk is used (false: one canonical path). Null when the model is not ShortestPaths, or the WCMP controller programs the demand.

parallel_edges.description: ShortestPaths and T1: whether every parallel link is used (false: one per node pair). Null when the model is neither, or the WCMP controller programs the demand.

tunnel_count.description: The tunnel count per head. Null when the model has no tunnels.

prefer_headroom.description: CentralizedTE: whether T2, after minimizing total tunnel cost, minimizes the plan's headroom penalty, based on occupied fractions of link capacity. Null when the model is not CentralizedTE.

cost_ceiling.description: The tunnels' cost ceiling. Null when there is none.

min_unreserved_bandwidth_units.description: T1: a setup-search filter (integer units of q): a tunnel's search uses a link only when its unreserved capacity is at least both the tunnel's request and this minimum; nothing is kept free. Null when the model is not T1.

route_names.description: The named routes of a pinned model. Null when the model is not pinned by named routes.

controller.description: The WCMP controller scope that programs the demand. Null when no controller programs it.

supplied_support.description: Whether a CentralizedTE model was given its own support DAG.

supplied_program.description: Whether a pinned model was given a native program (its routes are not exported).

hops.description: The path's hops in order; each hop lists the parallel directed links it may use.

residual.description: Request each row's per-link residual capacity.

edge_reservations.description: Request each row's per-link tunnel holds.

saturated_boundary_edges.description: Request each row's saturated boundary links.

min_cut.description: Request the minimum cut where it is defined.

request_kind.description: Whether the request is finite or unlimited.

requested_units.description: The request (integer units of q). Null when the request is unlimited.

offered_units.description: Lossy: the units sent into the network. Null when admission is lossless.

delivered_units.description: The units delivered to the destinations.

unadmitted_units.description: Lossless: the request minus the delivery; lossy: 0. Null when the request is unlimited.

source_drop_units.description: Lossy: units lost at sources without a usable route; 0 when lossless.

edge_drop_units.description: Lossy: units dropped on physical links and TE ingress pool attachments, in all; 0 when lossless.

termination.description: The native call's outcome. Values: complete (the offer is 0, admitted in full when lossless, or forwarded in full when lossy, its losses included); no_route (a positive offer and no source with a route); no_active_weight (the program has routes, but none of positive weight can send anything); exhausted (lossless and less than the offer admitted, or an unlimited offer).

total_cost.description: The controllers only (CentralizedTE without tunnels, ShortestPaths with optimized allocation): the exact sum over links of cost times carried units. Null when the model is another one (T1, T2, pinned, other ShortestPaths).

call_delivered_units.description: The units this call delivered. Absent when details are not requested.

call_undelivered_units.description: The request minus this call's delivery. Null when the request is unlimited. Absent when details are not requested.

delivery_delta_units.description: The delivery after the call minus before it. Absent when details are not requested.

call_edge_drops.description: This call's drops on physical links. Absent when details are not requested.

call_source_drop_units.description: This call's offered units lost at sources without a usable route. Absent when details are not requested.

admitted_units.description: Lossless: the units carried; lossy: the units offered. Absent when details are not requested.

edge_drops.description: Drops on physical links, by directed link. Absent when details are not requested.

by_source.description: One row per source, in source order (zero rows included). Absent when details are not requested.

by_tunnel.description: One row per tunnel of the program, in entry order. Absent when details are not requested.

plan.description: T1 and T2: the tunnel plan after the call. Null when the model is not T1 or T2. Absent when details are not requested, and in a tunnel-count row's result (the row records the plan).

edge_flows.description: The units each directed physical link carries. Absent when it was not requested.

residual.description: Each directed physical link's residual capacity (integer units of q): after this row, or, in simultaneous placement, the one final residual every row shares. Absent when it was not requested.

edge_reservations.description: Each directed physical link's tunnel holds (integer units of q). Absent when it was not requested.

saturated_boundary_edges.description: The saturated links at the sources' reachable boundary. Absent when it was not requested.

min_cut.description: The minimum cut closest to the sources, where one is defined (unrestricted optimized CentralizedTE at its maximum). Null when no cut is defined. Absent when it was not requested.

synthetic_ingress.description: Amounts on the private pool attachments (the synthetic ingress edges). Absent when the row has no TE ingress pool, or no native output is requested and details record no attachment drops.

include_disabled.description: Whether disabled nodes and links are counted.

excluded_nodes.description: Nodes left out of the statistics.

excluded_links.description: Links left out of the statistics.

id.description: The row's stable identifier within its analysis.

base_id.description: The declared demand's identifier, before expansion.

endpoints.description: The physical source and destination node names of the row.

count.description: The tunnels per head of this row (an up-to row: its limit).

up_to.description: Whether this row is the up-to row.

pool.description: The TE ingress pool the row's sources share. Null when the sources share no pool.

lossless_at_design_units.description: The lossless delivery at the design volume: min(design, the plan's lossless maximum).

physical_tunnel_cost.description: For a TE ingress pool: the total tunnel cost without the pool attachments; else the total tunnel cost.

plan.description: The tunnel plan after the call.

entry_id.description: The tunnel's entry identifier in the program.

head.description: The tunnel head: a node name, or the pool head of a TE ingress pool.

status.description: The tunnel's status in this forwarding. Values: up (set up and available for forwarding; it may carry zero units); insufficient_bandwidth (down: no path had enough unreserved bandwidth); cost_ceiling_exceeded (down: the cheapest path with enough bandwidth costs more than the cost ceiling); failed (repair state: a failure touches the tunnel, so its route is removed); blackholed (stale state: the tunnel stays up but its path reaches a failed node or link, where its traffic is dropped).

assigned_units.description: The units assigned to the tunnel (lossy: sent to it; lossless: carried).

total_edge_drop_units.description: Lossy: this tunnel's units dropped on physical links and TE ingress pool attachments; 0 when lossless.

tunnels_per_head.description: Tunnels per head (an up-to count: the chosen count).

design_kind.description: Whether the design volume is finite or unlimited.

design_demand_units.description: The design volume D (integer units of q). Null when the design is unlimited.

design_by_head.description: Each head's share of the design volume.

total_reserved_bandwidth_units.description: The holds of the up tunnels (integer units of q).

heads_with_capacity.description: T2: the live heads, those that reach a destination over links with at least one free unit (this policy's own traffic released). Null when the plan is T1's.

insufficient_resolution.description: T2: live heads exist but no whole unit per tunnel fits. Null when the plan is T1's.

max_fractional_bandwidth_per_tunnel.description: T2: the exact fluid optimum per tunnel (a fraction). Null when the plan is T1's.

max_bandwidth_per_tunnel_units.description: T2: the largest common whole-unit tunnel size U. Null when the plan is T1's.

planned_bandwidth_per_tunnel_units.description: T2: every tunnel's planned bandwidth u. Null when the plan is T1's.

total_planned_bandwidth_units.description: T2: the planned bandwidth over all tunnels. Null when the plan is T1's.

total_tunnel_cost.description: T2: the sum of link cost times tunnel count over the links (exact). Null when the plan is T1's.

headroom_penalty.description: T2 with prefer_headroom: the headroom penalty of the plan. Null when the plan is T1's or prefer_headroom is off.

max_lossless_offer_units.description: T2: the program's lossless maximum offer F. Null when the plan is T1's.

cost_distribution.description: Why the cost report is not derivable for this row. Absent when it is derivable or was not requested.

q.description: The bandwidth unit: one unit is q in physical terms.

exponent.description: q as a power of two: q = 2^exponent.

mode.description: auto (chosen by the recipe) or manual (declared).

target_met.description: Whether every declared input and split meets its precision bound at q. The bound is checked, not the rounding: false is possible with no input rounded.

input_convention.description: Physical inputs round half-up from their binary64 value.

display_convention.description: Units are authoritative; physical values are binary64 displays.

zeroed_inputs.description: Positive inputs that round to zero units.

max_absolute_input_error.description: The largest absolute input error (physical, a fraction).

max_relative_input_error.description: The largest absolute relative input error (a fraction).

augmented_capacity_sum_units.description: The graph's capacity sum with pool attachments (integer units of q).

augmented_cost_sum.description: The graph's cost sum with pool attachments.

nominal_split_count.description: Splits of the demands at alpha 1 without failures.

nominal_splits.description: Those splits with their bounds on q.

weight_approximations.description: Controller weights apportioned because they reached 2^62.

kind.description: The record kind, a fixed tag.

label.description: The input or constraint label: where the value is declared.

reason.description: The split is inside a supplied native program NetGraph cannot inspect.

lower_probe_index.description: The history index of the lower probe.

upper_probe_index.description: The history index of the upper probe.

kind.description: The record kind, a fixed tag.

label.description: The router (controller.<set>.<t>.router.<r>) or all_routers source (controller.<set>.<t>.source.<s>) whose weights were apportioned.

max_relative_error.description: The largest relative error of the apportioned weights (a fraction).
